newsitem.title: USA: Teleport pleased with ruling's timetable.
newsitem.headline: Teleport pleased with ruling's timetable.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said on Tuesday it was pleased the U.S. Justice Department ruling on the company's disvestment of Continental Cablevision holdings set a longer timetable than expected.

"We are pleased that the Justice Department has granted Continental Cablevision a longer timetable to reduce its stake in TCG than we anticipated," said Bob Annunziata, Teleport's chairman, president and chief executive.

Continental Cablevision holds a 11.2 percent stake in Teleport Communications Group. The ruling said Continental must reduce its stake to less than 10 percent by June 30, 1997, and then divest itself completely of TCG holdings by the end of 1998.
The divestiture is a regulatory pre-condition to the $11.8 billion merger of Continental Cablevision into U S West Communications Group Inc.
